data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native Arm A editorial: a serious midnight oracle still life with exactly one five-inch translucent yellow-green molded-plastic pickle-shaped fortune teller from the strict product reference standing on a small tarnished brass saucer over plum velvet in a dark midnight-blue room. Preserve its gentle curve, rounded ends, raised irregular bumps, and exactly one circular recessed answer-viewing window. Use restrained celestial side light and a faint crescent-shaped background reflection. The toy must not emit light. Omit the purple retail box and wizard packaging. No real edible pickle, glass, crystal, lamp, face, generic Magic 8 Ball, extra window, duplicate, readable text, person, hand, logo, watermark, CTA, badge, price, border, collage, or product-card frame.
notes: Full-resolution inspection shows one source-faithful translucent yellow-green molded pickle toy, one circular inset window, plausible five-inch scale on a small saucer, and coherent velvet/brass contact shadows.
There is no readable text, packaging, duplicate, person, hand, CTA, ad frame, invented second window, or visible structural AI defect.
